_comment: tourName -> Love Live! Fandom page title. Hand-curated escape hatch for lives the matcher cannot reach or gets wrong: 11 concert pages carry no {{Nihongo}} template, so they expose no Japanese title, and their romanised page names share too little with a Japanese tour name to match on. A null value asserts the live has no page of its own, so fuzzy matching must not borrow a related page's poster. Applied before fuzzy matching by scripts/enrich-live-thumbs.ts.
